page.overview:
Who is Colorful Parasaurolophus?

The colorful Parasaurolophus is a genetically modified hybrid of Parasaurolophus and tree frog that appears in Minecraft Jurassic World.

A colorful variant of the Parasaurolophus can be created in the game. In order to create it, a player must acquire 3 samples of Parasaurolophus DNA; 2 samples of any Medium DNA; and 1 sample of Tree Frog DNA.
